title: 第23章 不劳而获第24章 神兵天降
content_zh:
苏晚晴轻掩房门，嘴角不自觉扬起一抹温柔的笑意。
回想起方才少主那副手足无措的模样，她忍不住轻笑出声。
这样带着少年心性的少主，才真正值得她誓死追随。
门外长廊上，护卫们早已识趣地退去。
只有叶寒星一人静静伫立，见母亲出来，少年连忙上前：娘……
话到嘴边却又咽了回去。
十几岁的少年虽未经人事，却也懂得孤男寡女共处一室的含义。
更何况方才他分明听见屋内传出母亲痛苦的呻吟……
苏晚晴看出儿子的疑虑，却没有解释。
她只是缓缓抬起素手，一缕淡青色的玄气如烟似雾般在指尖流转。
这...！
叶寒星瞪大双眼，声音都在发颤。
星儿...苏晚晴眼中泪光闪动，声音哽咽，
娘可以修炼了。
她张开双臂，玄气在周身形成淡淡的光晕，
以后...再也不会拖你的后腿了。
叶寒星如遭雷击，随即猛地扑进母亲怀中。
少年强健的身躯微微发抖，滚烫的泪水打湿了苏晚晴的衣襟。
娘...太好了...真的太好了...
母子二人相拥而泣。

良久，叶寒星抹去眼泪，转身就要往屋里走：我去李过少主……
等等。
苏晚晴拉住儿子，轻声道：让少主静一静吧。
她望向紧闭的房门，眼中满是温柔，
若要报答少主，就努力修炼。
只有变得更强，才能真正帮到少主。
叶寒星重重点头，搀扶着母亲缓步离去。
夕阳将二人的影子拉得很长，渐渐消失在庭院尽头。
院落重归寂静，只剩下风吹树叶的沙沙声。
屋内，叶霄尘仰面躺在软榻上，双眼无神地望着房梁上的雕花纹路。
方才一番清理库存后，此刻的他身心通透，堪称一代贤者，连看世界的眼光都变得格外清明。
呼——
长舒一口气后，他猛地坐起身来，心念一动唤出系统界面：
【宿主：叶霄尘】
【修为：玄凝境三重（36%）】
【天赋：地品初级玄脉（地脉通幽——玄气吸收如江河奔涌，突破瓶颈时更易顿悟）】
content_en:
Su Wanqing gently opened the door, and a gentle smile unconsciously appeared at the corner of her mouth.
Recalling the helpless look of the young master just now, she couldn't help but chuckle.
Such a young master with a young heart is truly worthy of her following her to the death.
On the long corridor outside the door, the guards had already retreated in a sensible manner.
Ye Hanxing was the only one standing quietly. Seeing his mother coming out, the young man quickly stepped forward: Mom...
The words came to his lips but he swallowed them back.
Although teenagers have no experience in human affairs, they also understand the meaning of a man and a woman living alone in the same room.
What's more, he clearly heard his mother's painful moans coming from inside the house just now...
Su Wanqing saw her son's doubts, but did not explain.
She just slowly raised her bare hand, and a wisp of light blue mysterious energy flowed like smoke on her fingertips.
this...!
Ye Hanxing's eyes widened and his voice trembled.
Xing'er... Su Wanqing's eyes flashed with tears, her voice choked with sobs,
Mom can practice now.
She opened her arms, and Xuan Qi formed a faint halo around her body.
From now on... I will never hold you back again.
Ye Hanxing rushed into his mother's arms as if he was struck by lightning.
The young man's strong body trembled slightly, and his hot tears wet Su Wanqing's clothes.
Mom...it's so good...it's really good...
Mother and son hugged each other and cried.
After a long time, Ye Hanxing wiped away his tears, turned around and walked back into the house: I'm going to see Young Master Li Guo...
Wait.
Su Wanqing grabbed her son and said softly: "Young Master, please be quiet for a while."
She looked at the closed door, her eyes full of tenderness,
If you want to repay the young master, you must practice hard.
Only by becoming stronger can we truly help the young master.
Ye Hanxing nodded heavily, supported his mother and left slowly.
The setting sun stretched the shadows of the two people very long, and gradually disappeared at the end of the courtyard.
The courtyard returned to silence, except for the rustling of leaves in the wind.
Inside the house, Ye Xiaochen lay on his back on the soft couch, staring blankly at the carved patterns on the beams.
After cleaning up the inventory just now, he now has a clear mind and body. He can be called a sage. His vision of the world has become particularly clear.
Huh——
After taking a long breath, he sat up suddenly and called up the system interface with a thought:
[Host: Ye Xiaochen]
[Cultivation: Third level of Xuan Ning realm (36%)]
[Talent: Earth Grade Elementary Mysterious Veins (Earth Veins Connect to the Netherworld - Mysterious Qi is absorbed like a rushing river, making it easier to achieve enlightenment when breaking through bottlenecks)]
